title: Classic Platformer
summary: Readable, forgiving feel with a taller, floatier jump, more hang time, and broad landing readability.

runSpeed.whyItMatters: A moderate top speed keeps the world readable as the player runs.
runSpeed.suggestion: Set max horizontal speed near 7 u/s.

runAcceleration.whyItMatters: A visible ramp-up gives weight without feeling sluggish.
runAcceleration.suggestion: Lower ground acceleration so the player eases up to speed.

runDeceleration.whyItMatters: A short slide on release reads as classic momentum.
runDeceleration.suggestion: Reduce ground friction so the player skids slightly to a stop.

jumpApex.whyItMatters: A taller arc clears generous gaps and feels classic.
jumpApex.suggestion: Increase jump impulse so the apex sits near 3.8u.

timeToApex.whyItMatters: More hang time gives the player room to read and adjust mid-air.
timeToApex.suggestion: Tune jump impulse and rise gravity so the apex is reached in ~0.42s.

shortHopApex.whyItMatters: A readable short hop supports variable jump height.
shortHopApex.suggestion: Apply a gentle jump-cut so a tap peaks near 1.4u.

fallGravityMultiplier.whyItMatters: The classic 'fast fall after a floaty rise' asymmetry.
fallGravityMultiplier.suggestion: Set fall gravity to ~2x rise gravity.

coyoteTime.whyItMatters: A forgiving ledge window keeps casual play frustration-free.

jumpBuffer.whyItMatters: A generous buffer makes consecutive jumps feel reliable.
jumpBuffer.suggestion: Buffer a jump press for ~0.12s before grounding.
